item.title: HeyBuds 0.6.2
item.description:
• 耳机昵称与蓝牙服务识别的品牌冲突时，避免显示错误型号或启用不匹配的控制。清除手动型号后恢复自动识别结果。 • 设备设置复用按品牌排序的型号列表。蓝牙低功耗写入缓冲区满时，收到系统通知后再继续发送。 • 诊断文件仅保留最近 80 条事件。连接失败时记录传输方式和错误码，详细错误仍可在应用内查看。
• Respect the brand identified by the Bluetooth service when a nickname matches a different brand. Clearing a manual model restores automatic identification. • Reuse the sorted model list in device settings. Resume Bluetooth LE writes when macOS signals that buffer space is available. • Keep the latest 80 diagnostic events. Connection failures record the transport and error code, with the detailed message available in the app.
